issue.description:
Parent: the R041 umbrella (agent-friction:umbrella). Blocked by every R041 implementation child.

Scope:
- Build and pin per BUILD_PROCEDURE.md (scripts/build-from-archive.sh from a git-archive extraction, never inside the shared checkout), release, and install on codinghome and lab.
- Update agent-facing docs that describe the old behaviour: /home/coding/CLAUDE.md "Beads (bead-rs CLI)" (notes-replace gotcha, JSON shapes, fencing) and NEEDLE/CLAUDE.md wherever it shows the old forms.
- After at least 7 days of fleet use on the new binary, re-measure and record per-metric before/after on the umbrella.

Measurement method (reproducible without the scratch script that produced the baseline): stream every *.jsonl under ~/.claude/projects (pair Bash tool_use `input.command` with its tool_result by `tool_use_id`; take content and `is_error`) and ~/.codex/sessions (pair `response_item` function_call `arguments.cmd` with function_call_output by `call_id`). Select commands matching `(^|[\s;&|(])bead\s`, restrict to timestamps after the install, and count each umbrella metric. Normalise per 1,000 bead invocations, since volume varies.

Acceptance:
- The release is installed on both hosts, and `bead capabilities` advertises the R041 surfaces on each.
- The doc updates are committed and pushed.
- The measurement is recorded on the umbrella. Target: per 1,000 invocations, credential-required retries, JSON decode/unwrap failures and notes read-modify-write each fall at least 80% from baseline; any metric that does not gets a stated cause.

issue.description:
Plan section 6.2 step 6 requires applying pointer-declared tombstones once current.json is durable. They are declared and never applied.

Observed: current.json declared 18 deleted_paths and all 18 were still present on disk, and current.json wrongly listed itself among them. Ten mutate-and-flush cycles at ~1600 issues grew the checkpoint from 3 objects / 1.47 MB to 13 objects / 7.83 MB.

Acceptance:
- after a successful publication every path in deleted_paths is absent from disk
- current.json is never declared in its own deleted_paths (it belongs in replaced_paths)
- the retained object set is bounded by the generations current.json and previous.json reference
- sync --status reports unresolved tombstones and is not ready to commit while any remain
- cleanup is crash-safe and repeatable

Refs: plan 6.2 step 6, 6.2.1 P2; ADR-003.
issue.notes: Implemented in be427cd (source+tests), 2513c56 (man pages), 7d4ef35 (leftover consistency fixes). Publication now applies pointer-declared tombstones after the pointer commit (idempotent, NotFound=resolved, dirs synced), declares tombstones by enumerating objects/ and manifests/ so strays are re-declared until gone, bounds the retained set to the generations current.json+previous.json reference, and never declares current.json deleted. New 'bead sync status' gates ready_to_commit on unresolved tombstones, root verification, view agreement, state agreement, and freshness. Verified live: this workspace had 22 unresolved tombstones incl. the self-declared current.json; after one flush exactly the two referenced generation objects remain and status reports ready. Full suite: 653 passed / 0 failed; fmt and clippy clean.
issue.title: Apply pointer-declared checkpoint tombstones after the pointer commits
